subject: health
unitTitle: Balanced Eating, Hydration, and Active Living
title: Mastery check: hydration through the day
essentialQuestion: How can I plan food, water, and movement in a way that fits my body, my day, and my family?
materials: clean, empty food packages or printed sample labels
keyPoints: Water carries nutrients, controls temperature, and cushions joints.
Pale straw-coloured urine suggests you are drinking enough; dark yellow suggests not.
Needs rise with heat, illness, and activity.
Sugary and caffeinated drinks are not everyday hydration.
privacySafeScenario: Someone drinks only at meals, plays sport at midday in summer, and gets afternoon headaches. Suggest a plan.
studentTask: The learner applies what they learned about hydration through the day to a new fictional situation and records the choice plus the reason behind it.
knowledgeCheck: Explain hydration through the day to someone who has not learned it yet, using one example.
completionCriteria: The learner completes the central task about hydration through the day.
The learner gives a reason, an example, or a documented process rather than an unsupported answer.
The learner checks or revises the work and can name one next step.
adaptationChoices: Planning may use pictures, dictation, sorting cards, or a spoken walkthrough. Learners with allergies, medical diets, religious or cultural food practices, or limited food access plan with the foods actually available to them, and any example may be substituted.
extensionChallenge: Apply what you learned about hydration through the day under a new constraint, compare two reasonable approaches, or teach the idea to a family member with an original fictional example.
accessibilitySupports: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.
Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model.
Allow typed, handwritten, spoken, signed, drawn, or pointed responses; the response mode is never the standard being assessed.
Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, movement-break, and low-distraction options.
Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for any media.
Preserve the learning target while adjusting quantity, pacing, representation, or response mode.
trustedAdultNote: Direct urgent safety, health, or mental-health concerns to a trusted adult or qualified professional; this course is not diagnosis, therapy, or treatment.

optionalReflection.prompt: With a guardian, look at one food label from the cupboard and find the ingredients list and any allergen warning. This is optional. No purchase, account creation, photograph, measurement, or private disclosure is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
